+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:

+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def classify_question(text: str, text_status: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    lower = text.lower()
+    if not text or text_status in {"missing", "unavailable"}:
+        return {
+            "status": "abstain",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Available text is insufficient for a semantic method decision.",
+        }

+    has_integral = _contains(
+        text, r"(?:∫|\\int|\bintegr(?:al|ate|ating|ation)\b|antiderivative)"
+    )
+    has_geometry = _contains(text, r"\b(area|volume|rotated|revolution|shaded region)\b")
+    has_curve_recovery = _contains(
+        text,
+        r"(?:\bdy\s*/\s*dx\b|\bf['′]\s*\(|derivative|second derivative)"
+        r".{0,240}(?:equation of the curve|find f\s*\(|passes through)",
+    ) or _contains(
+        text,
+        r"(?:equation of the curve|find f\s*\().{0,240}"
+        r"(?:\bdy\s*/\s*dx\b|\bf['′]\s*\(|derivative)",
+    )
+    has_numeric_only = _contains(text, r"\b(trapezium|simpson|numerical integration)\b")
+    has_differential_equation = _contains(text, r"\bdifferential equation\b")
+    has_partial_fractions = _contains(text, r"\bpartial fractions?\b")
+    has_by_parts = _contains(text, r"\bintegration by parts\b|\busing parts\b")
+    has_substitution = _contains(
+        text, r"\b(?:use|using|by|given|put)\b.{0,40}\bsubstitut"
+    ) or _contains(text, r"\bu\s*=")
+    has_trig = has_integral and _contains(
+        text, r"\b(?:sin|cos|tan|sec|cosec|cot)\b|trigonometric"
+    )
+
+    if has_numeric_only and not (has_by_parts or has_substitution or has_partial_fractions):
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The visible demand is numerical integration rather than a symbolic antiderivative method.",
+        }
+    if has_differential_equation:
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Integration is subordinate to solving a differential equation, outside this family boundary.",
+        }
+    if has_partial_fractions and not has_integral:
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The question asks for partial-fraction algebra without an integration demand.",
+        }
+
+    primary = None
+    secondary: list[str] = []
+    rationale = ""
+    if has_by_parts:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.by_parts"
+        rationale = "The question explicitly requires integration by parts."
+    elif has_substitution and has_integral:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.substitution"
+        rationale = "A substantive change of variable is explicit in the integration demand."
+        if has_partial_fractions:
+            secondary.append("9709.type.integration.partial_fractions")
+    elif has_partial_fractions and has_integral:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.partial_fractions"
+        rationale = "Partial-fraction decomposition is coupled to exact integration."
+    elif has_trig:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.trigonometric"
+        rationale = "A trigonometric form or identity is central to the exact integral."
+    elif has_curve_recovery:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        rationale = "Recovering the curve from derivative data is the principal antiderivative demand."
+    elif has_integral and not has_geometry:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        rationale = "The question directly asks for a symbolic antiderivative or exact integral."
+    elif has_integral or has_geometry:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        return {
+            "status": "candidate",
+            "primary_question_type": primary,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Integration is visible, but geometry or mixed demands leave principal method ownership uncertain.",
+        }
+    else:
+        return {
+            "status": "abstain",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The Integration topic hint is not supported by a sufficiently explicit method demand in available text.",
+        }
+
+    return {
+        "status": "approved",
+        "primary_question_type": primary,
+        "secondary_question_types": secondary,
+        "rationale": rationale,
+    }

+def variant_tags(text: str, row: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    tags = []
+    patterns = (
+        ("definite_integral", r"(?:∫|\\int).{0,80}(?:_|from|to)|\bdefinite integral\b"),
+        ("improper_integral", r"\binfinity\b|\\infty|∞"),
+        ("curve_recovery", r"equation of the curve|find f\s*\("),

+        ("volume", r"\bvolume\b|revolution|rotated"),

+        nodes[node_id] = node
+
+    def add_edge(edge: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        edge_id = edge["edge_id"]
+        require(edge_id not in edges or edges[edge_id] == edge, f"duplicate edge: {edge_id}")
+        edges[edge_id] = edge
+
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Calculus",

+            "node_type": "Topic",
+            "status": "approved",
+            "topic_id": TOPIC_ID,
+        }
+    )

+            "node_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "node_type": "QuestionFamily",
+            "question_family_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "status": "approved",

+    model_by_type = {
+        model["question_type_id"]: model for model in procedures["procedure_models"]
+    }
+    for question_type in procedures["question_types"]:

+                "node_id": type_id,
+                "node_type": "QuestionType",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(_edge(FAMILY_ID, "CONTAINS", type_id, "approved"))
+        model = model_by_type[type_id]
+        model_id = model["procedure_model_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                "alternative_paths": model["alternative_paths"],
+                "applicability_conditions": model["applicability_conditions"],
+                "common_traps": model["common_traps"],
+                "label": model["label"],
+                "node_id": model_id,

+                "representative_question_refs": model["representative_question_refs"],

+                type_id,

+    type_order = {

+        "QuestionFamily": 4,
+        "QuestionType": 5,

+        value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
+    ).encode()
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise SemanticKgError(f"unreadable JSON input: {path}: {exc}") from exc
+    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"JSON input must be an object: {path}")
+    return value
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_bytes(canonical_bytes(value))
+
+
+def load_structural_builder(repo: Path) -> Any:
+    path = repo / STRUCTURAL_BUILDER_RELATIVE
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("issue_1714_structural_builder", path)
+    require(spec is not None and spec.loader is not None, "structural builder unavailable")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _input_record(repo: Path, relative: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = repo / relative
+    require(path.is_file(), f"required input missing: {relative}")
+    return {
+        "byte_length": path.stat().st_size,
+        "path": relative.as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+    }
+
+
+def _normalized_text(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    value = item.get("normalized_plain_text")
+    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
+
+
+def _contains(text: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
+    return re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL) is not None
+
+
+def classify_question(text: str, text_status: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    lower = text.lower()

+        return {
+            "status": "abstain",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Available text is insufficient for a semantic method decision.",
+        }
+
+    has_integral = _contains(
+        text, r"(?:∫|\\int|\bintegr(?:al|ate|ating|ation)\b|antiderivative)"
+    )
+    has_geometry = _contains(text, r"\b(area|volume|rotated|revolution|shaded region)\b")
+    has_curve_recovery = _contains(
+        text,
+        r"(?:\bdy\s*/\s*dx\b|\bf['′]\s*\(|derivative|second derivative)"
+        r".{0,240}(?:equation of the curve|find f\s*\(|passes through)",
+    ) or _contains(
+        text,
+        r"(?:equation of the curve|find f\s*\().{0,240}"
+        r"(?:\bdy\s*/\s*dx\b|\bf['′]\s*\(|derivative)",
+    )
+    has_numeric_only = _contains(text, r"\b(trapezium|simpson|numerical integration)\b")
+    has_differential_equation = _contains(text, r"\bdifferential equation\b")
+    has_partial_fractions = _contains(text, r"\bpartial fractions?\b")
+    has_by_parts = _contains(text, r"\bintegration by parts\b|\busing parts\b")
+    has_substitution = _contains(
+        text, r"\b(?:use|using|by|given|put)\b.{0,40}\bsubstitut"
+    ) or _contains(text, r"\bu\s*=")
+    has_trig = has_integral and _contains(
+        text, r"\b(?:sin|cos|tan|sec|cosec|cot)\b|trigonometric"
+    )
+
+    if has_numeric_only and not (has_by_parts or has_substitution or has_partial_fractions):
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The visible demand is numerical integration rather than a symbolic antiderivative method.",
+        }
+    if has_differential_equation:
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Integration is subordinate to solving a differential equation, outside this family boundary.",
+        }
+    if has_partial_fractions and not has_integral:
+        return {
+            "status": "rejected",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The question asks for partial-fraction algebra without an integration demand.",
+        }
+
+    primary = None
+    secondary: list[str] = []
+    rationale = ""
+    if has_by_parts:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.by_parts"
+        rationale = "The question explicitly requires integration by parts."
+    elif has_substitution and has_integral:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.substitution"
+        rationale = "A substantive change of variable is explicit in the integration demand."
+        if has_partial_fractions:
+            secondary.append("9709.type.integration.partial_fractions")
+    elif has_partial_fractions and has_integral:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.partial_fractions"
+        rationale = "Partial-fraction decomposition is coupled to exact integration."
+    elif has_trig:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.trigonometric"
+        rationale = "A trigonometric form or identity is central to the exact integral."
+    elif has_curve_recovery:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        rationale = "Recovering the curve from derivative data is the principal antiderivative demand."
+    elif has_integral and not has_geometry:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        rationale = "The question directly asks for a symbolic antiderivative or exact integral."
+    elif has_integral or has_geometry:
+        primary = "9709.type.integration.direct_reverse_chain"
+        return {
+            "status": "candidate",
+            "primary_question_type": primary,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "Integration is visible, but geometry or mixed demands leave principal method ownership uncertain.",
+        }
+    else:
+        return {
+            "status": "abstain",
+            "primary_question_type": None,
+            "secondary_question_types": [],
+            "rationale": "The Integration topic hint is not supported by a sufficiently explicit method demand in available text.",
+        }
+
+    return {
+        "status": "approved",
+        "primary_question_type": primary,
+        "secondary_question_types": secondary,
+        "rationale": rationale,
+    }

+
+def variant_tags(text: str, row: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    tags = []
+    patterns = (
+        ("definite_integral", r"(?:∫|\\int).{0,80}(?:_|from|to)|\bdefinite integral\b"),
+        ("improper_integral", r"\binfinity\b|\\infty|∞"),
+        ("curve_recovery", r"equation of the curve|find f\s*\("),
+        ("area", r"\barea\b"),
+        ("volume", r"\bvolume\b|revolution|rotated"),
+        ("cross_page", r"\badditional page\b"),
+    )
+    for tag, pattern in patterns:
+        if _contains(text, pattern):
+            tags.append(tag)
+    if row.get("requires_image_context"):
+        tags.append("visual_context_available")
+    return tags
+
+
+def _edge(source: str, edge_type: str, target: str, status: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    identity = [source, edge_type, target, status]
+    return {
+        "edge_id": f"edge::{sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(identity))}",
+        "edge_type": edge_type,
+        "from_node_id": source,
+        "inferred": False,
+        "status": status,
+        "to_node_id": target,
+    }
+
+
+def _evidence_index(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any], edges_document: dict[str, Any]
+) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, list[str]]]:
+    nodes = {node["node_id"]: node for node in nodes_document["nodes"]}
+    outgoing: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for edge in edges_document["edges"]:
+        if edge["edge_type"] == "SUPPORTED_BY":
+            outgoing[edge["from_node_id"]].append(edge["to_node_id"])
+    return nodes, outgoing
+
+
+def build_registry(
+    repo: Path,
+    structural_nodes: dict[str, Any],
+    structural_edges: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_map = read_json(repo / SOURCE_MAP_RELATIVE)
+    plain_text = read_json(repo / PLAIN_TEXT_RELATIVE)
+    nodes, support = _evidence_index(structural_nodes, structural_edges)
+    verified = {
+        node_id for node_id, node in nodes.items() if node.get("node_type") == "Question"
+    }
+    text_by_storage = {
+        item["storage_key"]: (index, item)
+        for index, item in enumerate(plain_text.get("items", []))
+        if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("storage_key"), str)
+    }
+    selected = [
+        row
+        for row in source_map.get("rows", [])
+        if isinstance(row, dict)
+        and str(row.get("primary_topic_path", "")).endswith(".integration")
+        and row.get("question_key") in verified
+    ]
+    selected.sort(key=lambda row: row["question_key"])
+    require(
+        len(selected) == EXPECTED_DISCOVERED,
+        f"discoverable Integration Techniques membership drift: {len(selected)}",
+    )
+
+    records = []
+    for row in selected:
+        question_id = row["question_key"]
+        text_entry = text_by_storage.get(row.get("storage_key"))
+        require(text_entry is not None, f"plain text join missing: {question_id}")
+        text_index, item = text_entry
+        text = _normalized_text(item)
+        decision = classify_question(
+            text, str(row.get("normalized_plain_text_status", "missing"))
+        )
+        part_ids = sorted(
+            node_id
+            for node_id, node in nodes.items()
+            if node.get("node_type") == "QuestionPart"
+            and node.get("question_id") == question_id
+        )
+        representative_part = next(
+            (
+                part_id
+                for part_id in part_ids
+                if any(nodes[anchor].get("source_role") == "ms" for anchor in support[part_id])
+            ),
+            part_ids[0] if part_ids else None,
+        )
+        qp_anchors = sorted(
+            {
+                anchor
+                for owner in [question_id, *part_ids]
+                for anchor in support[owner]
+                if nodes[anchor].get("source_role") == "qp"
+            }
+        )
+        ms_anchors = sorted(
+            {
+                anchor
+                for owner in part_ids
+                for anchor in support[owner]
+                if nodes[anchor].get("source_role") == "ms"
+            }
+        )
+        require(qp_anchors and ms_anchors, f"exact QP/MS evidence missing: {question_id}")
+        evidence_refs = {
+            "question_ref": question_id,
+            "representative_question_part_ref": representative_part,
+            "qp_evidence_anchor_ref": qp_anchors[0],
+            "ms_evidence_anchor_ref": ms_anchors[0],
+            "source_text_ref": {
+                "path": PLAIN_TEXT_RELATIVE.as_posix(),
+                "json_pointer": f"/items/{text_index}/normalized_plain_text",
+                "sha256": sha256_bytes(text.encode()),
+            },
+        }
+        record = {
+            "evidence_refs": evidence_refs,
+            "primary_question_type": decision["primary_question_type"],
+            "question_id": question_id,
+            "review_rationale": decision["rationale"],
+            "secondary_question_types": decision["secondary_question_types"],
+            "status": decision["status"],
+            "variant_tags": variant_tags(text, row),
+        }
+        record["semantic_record_sha256"] = sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(record))
+        records.append(record)
+
+    counts = Counter(record["status"] for record in records)
+    return {
+        "authority_binding": {
+            "issue_creation_baseline": ISSUE_CREATION_BASELINE,
+            "kg_starting_authority": STARTING_AUTHORITY,
+            "structural_question_count": len(verified),
+        },
+        "discovery_rule": (
+            "primary_topic_path ends with .integration and question identity is present "
+            "in the admitted 3,497-row structural authority"
+        ),
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "records": records,
+        "schema_version": "9709_integration_techniques_semantic_registry_v1",
+        "summary": {
+            "abstain_question_count": counts["abstain"],
+            "approved_question_count": counts["approved"],
+            "candidate_question_count": counts["candidate"],
+            "discovered_family_question_count": len(records),
+            "rejected_question_count": counts["rejected"],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def build_procedure_library(registry: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    approved = [
+        record for record in registry["records"] if record["status"] == "approved"
+    ]
+    by_type: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for record in approved:
+        by_type[record["primary_question_type"]].append(record)
+
+    question_types = []
+    models = []
+    for type_id, definition in TYPE_DEFINITIONS.items():
+        records = sorted(by_type[type_id], key=lambda record: record["question_id"])
+        require(len(records) >= 2, f"approved procedure is not reusable: {type_id}")
+        representatives = [
+            {
+                "question_id": record["question_id"],
+                "question_part_id": record["evidence_refs"][
+                    "representative_question_part_ref"
+                ],
+            }
+            for record in records[:3]
+        ]
+        question_types.append(
+            {
+                "label": definition["label"],
+                "question_family_id": FAMILY_ID,
+                "question_type_id": type_id,
+                "status": "approved",
+            }
+        )
+        steps = [
+            {
+                "action": action,
+                "applicability_conditions": (
+                    definition["applicability"] if index == 1 else []
+                ),
+                "procedure_step_id": f"{definition['model_id']}.step.{index:02d}",
+                "sequence": index,
+                "status": "approved",
+            }
+            for index, action in enumerate(definition["steps"], start=1)
+        ]
+        models.append(
+            {
+                "alternative_paths": definition["alternative_paths"],
+                "applicability_conditions": definition["applicability"],
+                "common_traps": definition["common_traps"],
+                "label": definition["model_label"],
+                "procedure_model_id": definition["model_id"],
+                "procedure_steps": steps,

+            }

+    questions_per_model = {
+        TYPE_DEFINITIONS[type_id]["model_id"]: len(records)
+        for type_id, records in sorted(by_type.items())
+    }

+    return {
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "procedure_models": models,
+        "question_types": question_types,
+        "schema_version": "9709_integration_techniques_procedure_library_v1",
+        "summary": {
+            "approved_question_type_count": len(question_types),
+            "procedure_model_count": len(models),
+            "procedure_reuse_ratio": round(total_bindings / len(models), 6),
+            "questions_per_procedure_model": questions_per_model,
+            "singleton_candidate_count": 0,

+
+
+def build_review_record(
+    registry: dict[str, Any], procedures: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:

+            "question_id": record["question_id"],
+            "rationale": record["review_rationale"],
+            "semantic_record_sha256": record["semantic_record_sha256"],

+        for record in registry["records"]

+    return {
+        "independence_posture": {
+            "historical_accepted_fields_inherited": False,
+            "historical_run_directories_published": False,
+            "review_basis": "current text plus exact current structural QP/MS evidence",
+            "required_exact_head_review": True,

+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "procedure_library_sha256": sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(procedures)),
+        "registry_sha256": sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(registry)),

+        "schema_version": "9709_integration_techniques_semantic_review_delta_v1",

+def project_semantics(
+    base_nodes: dict[str, Any],
+    base_edges: dict[str, Any],
+    registry: dict[str, Any],
+    procedures: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    nodes = {node["node_id"]: node for node in base_nodes["nodes"]}
+    edges = {edge["edge_id"]: edge for edge in base_edges["edges"]}
+
+    def add_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        node_id = node["node_id"]
+        require(node_id not in nodes or nodes[node_id] == node, f"duplicate node: {node_id}")
+        nodes[node_id] = node
+
+    def add_edge(edge: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        edge_id = edge["edge_id"]
+        require(edge_id not in edges or edges[edge_id] == edge, f"duplicate edge: {edge_id}")
+        edges[edge_id] = edge
+
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Calculus",
+            "node_id": TOPIC_ID,
+            "node_type": "Topic",
+            "status": "approved",
+            "topic_id": TOPIC_ID,
+        }
+    )
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Integration Techniques",
+            "node_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "node_type": "QuestionFamily",
+            "question_family_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "status": "approved",
+        }
+    )
+    add_edge(_edge(TOPIC_ID, "CONTAINS", FAMILY_ID, "approved"))
+
+    model_by_type = {
+        model["question_type_id"]: model for model in procedures["procedure_models"]
+    }
+    for question_type in procedures["question_types"]:
+        type_id = question_type["question_type_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **question_type,
+                "node_id": type_id,
+                "node_type": "QuestionType",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(_edge(FAMILY_ID, "CONTAINS", type_id, "approved"))
+        model = model_by_type[type_id]
+        model_id = model["procedure_model_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                "alternative_paths": model["alternative_paths"],
+                "applicability_conditions": model["applicability_conditions"],
+                "common_traps": model["common_traps"],
+                "label": model["label"],
+                "node_id": model_id,
+                "node_type": "ProcedureModel",
+                "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                "question_type_id": type_id,
+                "representative_question_refs": model["representative_question_refs"],
+                "status": "approved",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(_edge(type_id, "USES_PROCEDURE", model_id, "approved"))
+        for step in model["procedure_steps"]:
+            step_id = step["procedure_step_id"]
+            add_node(
+                {
+                    **step,
+                    "node_id": step_id,
+                    "node_type": "ProcedureStep",
+                    "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                }
+            )
+            add_edge(_edge(model_id, "HAS_STEP", step_id, "approved"))
+
+    for record in registry["records"]:
+        if record["status"] not in {"approved", "candidate"}:
+            continue
+        type_ids = [
+            record["primary_question_type"],
+            *record["secondary_question_types"],
+        ]
+        for index, type_id in enumerate(type_ids):
+            require(type_id in model_by_type, f"unknown projected type: {type_id}")
+            classification = _edge(
+                record["question_id"],
+                "CLASSIFIED_AS",
+                type_id,
+                record["status"],
+            )
+            classification["classification_role"] = (
+                "primary" if index == 0 else "secondary"
+            )
+            add_edge(classification)
+
+    type_order = {
+        "Question": 0,
+        "QuestionPart": 1,
+        "EvidenceAnchor": 2,
+        "Topic": 3,
+        "QuestionFamily": 4,
+        "QuestionType": 5,
+        "ProcedureModel": 6,
+        "ProcedureStep": 7,
+    }
+    return (
+        {
+            **base_nodes,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "nodes": sorted(
+                nodes.values(),
+                key=lambda node: (type_order[node["node_type"]], node["node_id"]),
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            **base_edges,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "edges": sorted(edges.values(), key=lambda edge: edge["edge_id"]),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def validate_semantic_release(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+    registry: dict[str, Any],
+    procedures: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, int | str]:
+    nodes = nodes_document["nodes"]
+    edges = edges_document["edges"]
+    node_index = {node["node_id"]: node for node in nodes}
+    require(len(node_index) == len(nodes), "duplicate active identity")
+    require(len({edge["edge_id"] for edge in edges}) == len(edges), "duplicate active edge")
+    dangling = sum(
+        edge["from_node_id"] not in node_index or edge["to_node_id"] not in node_index
+        for edge in edges
+    )
+    unsupported = sum(edge.get("inferred") is not False for edge in edges)
+    require(dangling == 0, "dangling edge")
+    require(unsupported == 0, "unsupported inferred edge")
+
+    registry_by_question = {
+        record["question_id"]: record for record in registry["records"]
+    }
+    classified = [
+        edge for edge in edges if edge["edge_type"] == "CLASSIFIED_AS"
+    ]
+    candidate_exposed = sum(
+        edge["status"] == "approved"
+        and registry_by_question[edge["from_node_id"]]["status"] == "candidate"
+        for edge in classified
+    )
+    require(candidate_exposed == 0, "candidate exposed as approved")
+    for record in registry["records"]:
+        require(record["status"] in ALLOWED_DISPOSITIONS, "invalid semantic disposition")
+        require(record["question_id"] in node_index, "semantic question is not structural")
+        refs = record["evidence_refs"]
+        require(
+            node_index.get(refs["qp_evidence_anchor_ref"], {}).get("source_role") == "qp"
+            and node_index.get(refs["ms_evidence_anchor_ref"], {}).get("source_role") == "ms",
+            "semantic evidence is not exact QP/MS authority",
+        )
+        matching = [
+            edge
+            for edge in classified
+            if edge["from_node_id"] == record["question_id"]
+        ]

+                "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                "question_type_id": type_id,
+                "representative_question_refs": model["representative_question_refs"],
+                "status": "approved",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(_edge(type_id, "USES_PROCEDURE", model_id, "approved"))
+        for step in model["procedure_steps"]:
+            step_id = step["procedure_step_id"]
+            add_node(
+                {
+                    **step,
+                    "node_id": step_id,
+                    "node_type": "ProcedureStep",
+                    "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+                }
+            )
+            add_edge(_edge(model_id, "HAS_STEP", step_id, "approved"))
+
+    for record in registry["records"]:
+        if record["status"] not in {"approved", "candidate"}:
+            continue
+        type_ids = [
+            record["primary_question_type"],
+            *record["secondary_question_types"],
+        ]
+        for index, type_id in enumerate(type_ids):
+            require(type_id in model_by_type, f"unknown projected type: {type_id}")
+            classification = _edge(
+                record["question_id"],
+                "CLASSIFIED_AS",
+                type_id,
+                record["status"],
+            )
+            classification["classification_role"] = (
+                "primary" if index == 0 else "secondary"
+            )
+            add_edge(classification)
+
+    type_order = {
+        "Question": 0,
+        "QuestionPart": 1,
+        "EvidenceAnchor": 2,
+        "Topic": 3,
+        "QuestionFamily": 4,
+        "QuestionType": 5,
+        "ProcedureModel": 6,
+        "ProcedureStep": 7,
+    }
+    return (
+        {
+            **base_nodes,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "nodes": sorted(
+                nodes.values(),
+                key=lambda node: (type_order[node["node_type"]], node["node_id"]),
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            **base_edges,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "edges": sorted(edges.values(), key=lambda edge: edge["edge_id"]),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def validate_semantic_release(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+    registry: dict[str, Any],
+    procedures: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, int | str]:
+    nodes = nodes_document["nodes"]
+    edges = edges_document["edges"]
+    node_index = {node["node_id"]: node for node in nodes}
+    require(len(node_index) == len(nodes), "duplicate active identity")
+    require(len({edge["edge_id"] for edge in edges}) == len(edges), "duplicate active edge")
+    dangling = sum(
+        edge["from_node_id"] not in node_index or edge["to_node_id"] not in node_index
+        for edge in edges
+    )
+    unsupported = sum(edge.get("inferred") is not False for edge in edges)
+    require(dangling == 0, "dangling edge")
+    require(unsupported == 0, "unsupported inferred edge")
+
+    registry_by_question = {
+        record["question_id"]: record for record in registry["records"]
+    }
+    classified = [
+        edge for edge in edges if edge["edge_type"] == "CLASSIFIED_AS"
+    ]
+    candidate_exposed = sum(
+        edge["status"] == "approved"
+        and registry_by_question[edge["from_node_id"]]["status"] == "candidate"
+        for edge in classified
+    )
+    require(candidate_exposed == 0, "candidate exposed as approved")
+    for record in registry["records"]:
+        require(record["status"] in ALLOWED_DISPOSITIONS, "invalid semantic disposition")
+        require(record["question_id"] in node_index, "semantic question is not structural")
+        refs = record["evidence_refs"]
+        require(
+            node_index.get(refs["qp_evidence_anchor_ref"], {}).get("source_role") == "qp"
+            and node_index.get(refs["ms_evidence_anchor_ref"], {}).get("source_role") == "ms",
+            "semantic evidence is not exact QP/MS authority",
+        )
+        matching = [
+            edge
+            for edge in classified
+            if edge["from_node_id"] == record["question_id"]
+        ]
+        expected = (
+            1 + len(record["secondary_question_types"])
+            if record["status"] in {"approved", "candidate"}
+            else 0
+        )
+        require(len(matching) == expected, "semantic projection disposition mismatch")
+        require(
+            all(edge["status"] == record["status"] for edge in matching),
+            "semantic edge status mismatch",
+        )
+        if matching:
+            require(
+                sum(edge.get("classification_role") == "primary" for edge in matching)
+                == 1
+                and sum(
+                    edge.get("classification_role") == "secondary"
+                    for edge in matching
+                )
+                == len(record["secondary_question_types"]),
+                "semantic classification role mismatch",
+            )
+
+    status_counts = Counter(record["status"] for record in registry["records"])
+    approved_types = {
+        record["primary_question_type"]
+        for record in registry["records"]
+        if record["status"] == "approved"
+    }
+    procedure_models = procedures["procedure_models"]
+    require(status_counts["approved"] > 0, "zero approved semantic mappings")
+    require(len(procedure_models) > 0, "zero reusable approved procedures")
+    require(
+        all(
+            len(model["representative_question_refs"]) > 0
+            and len(model["procedure_steps"]) > 0
+            for model in procedure_models
+        ),
+        "procedure model is incomplete",
+    )
+    return {
+        "candidate_exposed_as_approved_count": candidate_exposed,
+        "dangling_edge_count": dangling,
+        "deterministic_rebuild": "PASS",
+        "duplicate_active_identity_count": 0,
+        "exact_qp_ms_evidence_readback": "PASS",
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "remote_write_count": 0,
+        "safe_rejection_input_count": 0,
+        "stale_authority_reference_count": 0,
+        "structural_authority_write_count": 0,
+        "unsupported_inferred_edge_count": unsupported,
+        "verified_input_question_count": 3497,
+        "approved_question_type_count": len(approved_types),
+    }
+
+
+def projection_counts(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any], edges_document: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "edges_by_type": dict(
+            sorted(Counter(edge["edge_type"] for edge in edges_document["edges"]).items())
+        ),
+        "nodes_by_type": dict(
+            sorted(Counter(node["node_type"] for node in nodes_document["nodes"]).items())
+        ),
+        "total_edges": len(edges_document["edges"]),
+        "total_nodes": len(nodes_document["nodes"]),
+    }
